pursuit: ax-llm training + idea + verify + rank loop over product-brief generator
note: This pursuit does not edit a single file — each proposer designs a multi-file subsystem (trace collection, training, judge, idea generator, governor) that composes on top of the existing PR. Proposers write into src/training/<variant>/ + scripts/<variant>-*.mjs and expose a standard entrypoint described in the proposer brief.

dimensionClaims.ideasaiCapHit: Jaccard of attached vs expected capability layers on the ideasai corpus. If this moves up, downstream scaffolds ship with the UI/infra layers the user described (layout-dashboard, ai-chat-ui, saas-billing), so the agent doesn't have to install and wire them by hand. Each missed capability ≈ 10-60 min of agent time per project. Target: 0.452 → >0.65.
dimensionClaims.heldOutCapHit: Same metric on held-out-validation. Claim: prevents overfitting to the training corpus. If heldOut moves up with ideasai, the brief generator is learning general scaffold patterns, not memorizing ideasai. If heldOut stays flat or drops while ideasai moves up, we've overfit and the training loop is producing slop.
dimensionClaims.briefP95Ms: End-to-end p95 latency on prompts that trigger the brief path (non-high router confidence). Claim: this is the user-perceived latency when the brief fires — gates how long they wait before the scaffold is ready. Hard cap: 800ms for live use, 3000ms for batch/offline training passes. Above 800ms the rewriter gate should reject the LLM call.
dimensionClaims.judgeAgreement: Correlation between the LLM-as-judge scoring of candidate scaffolds and a held-out set of human-scored scaffolds. Claim: if the judge doesn't agree with human judgment, judge-driven ranking is noise — promoting 'winners' that humans hate. Minimum: Pearson r ≥ 0.6 vs a ≥10-sample human-scored set.
dimensionClaims.archetypePromotionYield: Count of net-new archetypes generated by the idea generator that (a) pass the judge with a score above the baseline archetype median AND (b) improve held-out capHit when merged into registry/. Claim: this is the only measure that proves the FULL loop works end-to-end. A variant with 0 promotable archetypes is a failed training loop even if every individual stage passed. Target: ≥5.

constraints: All LLM calls MUST go through router.tangle.tools using TANGLE_ROUTER_USER_KEY. Never use provider keys directly.
Reuse src/lib/llm.ts (createLLM, detectProvider) as the ONLY client factory. Do not instantiate ax AI clients directly.
Reuse src/lib/product-brief.ts ProductBrief interface. Training produces an AxOptimizedProgram serialized to .evolve/optimized/brief-<variant>.json; at runtime product-brief.ts loads it if present.
Extend scripts/meta-harness-eval.mjs + scripts/meta-harness-matrix.mjs. Do NOT fork them.
Trace storage goes under .evolve/traces/ — append-only JSONL.
Training output goes under .evolve/optimized/ — one file per optimized program.
Judge output goes under .evolve/judge/ — JSONL per candidate.
Idea proposals go under .evolve/ideas/ — JSON per run.
Extend tests/ with variant-specific test files (tests/training-<variant>.test.ts). Do NOT create new test runners.
Hot path (planPrompt default) stays deterministic. All training-loop code is behind flags or runs offline.
